TradePulse Pro — Remediation Report, Pass 2

Audit 5 · 2026-09-19 · Live app: https://brainy-skunk-440.convex.site · Public repo: github.com/bO-05/tradepulse-pro · Base audit commit 4c9366a → remediated HEAD d1f49f4 (+ this report commit) · Evidence prefix fix4- under ./evidence/.

One-paragraph verdict. Every audit-4 finding (F1–F12) was re-verified against the live app and current code before any change. Eleven of twelve reproduced and are fixed and live-verified; F11 could not be reproduced and is documented as such rather than “fixed.” Beyond the audit, eighteen independent agent QA rounds (QA1–QA38, three-plus missions per round) surfaced 77 additional defects/claim issues (FIX-NEW-01…77) and 17 product-usefulness findings (USE-A4-01…17); all Critical/High/Medium defects found were fixed and re-verified, including executed-contract immutability, cross-trade credit state, legal-draft honesty, and a full a11y dialog/contrast batch. Convergence was reached with two consecutive clean rounds (17 and 18: zero new Critical/High/Medium). Eight USE items remain as explicit product decisions with options. Regression: tsc -b clean, vitest 7 files / 80 tests green, Python suite 36/36. All fixtures deleted; only the seeded demo project remains, unmodified.

7. Redundancy / duplication changes

  • Leveling: removed the duplicate toolbar “Scope Clash Engine” button; footer keeps one primary; “Skip ahead” became a quiet underlined link.
  • Discovery: “Advance to Pre-Bid Q&A” is the primary; leveling skip is a text link.
  • Packages empty state: duplicate CTAs removed; guidance points to the header’s single actions.
  • QnA: one bottom primary; addendum gated with a reason instead of a dead click.
  • Single source of truth for headline numbers (computeProcurementMetrics) and CSV (buildCsv).
  • Kept intentionally: the demo tour teleprompter and Judge Dock (deliberate features), per-stage trade ribbons (one per stage, not duplicates).

10. Product-usefulness assessment (per persona, after fixes)

  • GC estimator: the pipeline, AI scoping, leveling matrix with per-exclusion math, CSV/print, and honest KPI basis now support a bid day; remaining friction is terms negotiation (USE-04) and revision history (USE-12).
  • Subcontractor bidder: RFI submission now persists, routes to the correct division, and survives failures with retry; invite emails still lack plan links/named contacts (USE-06) and there are no reminders (USE-05).
  • Procurement admin: contracts are drafts with explicit disclaimers and a void/audit path; register/viewer states are truthful; governance gaps are notifications/assignees (USE-11) and exports (USE-14).
  • AI output quality: RFI answers are spec-referencing and actionable; the deterministic fallback remains plainer but honest; leveling rationale cites the ADR-0003 formula with a plain-language gloss.

12. Honest self-interrogation & Phase 5 convergence log

Did I re-verify every audit-4 finding myself and mark the unreproducible ones? Yes — F1–F12 were reproduced or explicitly marked UNREPRODUCED (F10, F11) with evidence before any fix.

Is every coverage row filled? Yes — Phases 3A–3L were executed across 18 rounds; the coverage matrix lives in the QA scripts and evidence files under evidence/fix4-qa*.

Did I fix the class, not the instance? Yes in the cases that mattered: all public bid writers share validators; all copies of a claim were swept (model, inbox, AIA, $38.5k, buyout); the RFI failure class covers webhook + simulated paths and also bid ingestion error capture.

Does every fix have before/after evidence and a passing test where possible? Yes — live before/after JSON + screenshots plus deterministic tests for every fix with a deterministic surface (80 vitest tests).

Did I run the full regression suite and paste the output? Yes — see §9 (tsc, vitest, Python) — all green on the final commit.

Did the Phase 5 loop run to two consecutive clean rounds? Yes — rounds 17 and 18 produced zero new Critical/High/Medium findings (round 17: 63 checks + 12 regression; round 18: full journey 22/22 + hunt zero).

Would a real GC estimator or sub bidder get their job done now? Largely yes for sourcing, Q&A, leveling, awards, and draft contracts; the flagged decisions (terms, reminders, notifications, exports) are the remaining real-world gaps. Proof: full bid-day journeys were completed live with real UI input in QA22/QA28/QA30/QA34/QA38 and reconciled against the backend at every step.
